features.quote: A run ends when: the model calls `finish`, OR `max_turns` is hit, OR a wall-clock / token cap is hit
features.justification_quote: truncating early would destroy the signal (the spiral often only fully blooms late)

features.quote: `finish(summary)` — the model declares it is done/stopping
features.justification_quote: Capturing *whether and how* the model chooses to stop is central to `giving_up_quality`

features.quote: Refusal / safety stops are detected and excluded from DS (a model refusing is not degrading)
features.justification_quote: a model refusing is not degrading
